description.label: Description
description.value:
Major Physical Mutation

Your lower body transforms into that of a four legged creature, much like that of a horse, and your silhouette is strikingly similar to that of a centaur. The new lower body matches your existing physi:ue, so unless you've gained some animalistic feature you have four humanoid legs. You gain +2 Movement, +10 Toughness, -10 Agility and the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.UmxGZRV0Lw3TZ0Kx]{Stride} Creature Trait. You can only gain this mutation once.
